description: List Facility Condition Index (FCI) history for sites. fci_value is deferred renewal cost divided by current replacement value, a fraction where LOWER is healthier: below 0.05 good, 0.05-0.10 fair, 0.10 and above poor. It is not a 0-100 condition score. To chart one site, use show_site_fci_trend.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_site_fci_history
title: List site FCI history
